fixtures.source: In the Nexus protocol stack, `handshake` designates the initial connection phase, `streaming` designates active data transfer, and `teardown` designates graceful disconnection. The `SessionManager` transitions from `handshake` to `streaming` when callback `onReady()` returns `ACK_RECEIVED`. It transitions from `streaming` to `teardown` when `close()` is invoked via `connection.terminate()`. Protocol specification is at [Nexus Protocol v2](https://spec.nexus.invalid/v2) under **State Transitions**. Error handling is at [Error Codes](https://spec.nexus.invalid/errors) under **Recovery Procedures**. The system must preserve diagnostic `ERR_NEXUS invalid state transition handshake->teardown`.
